Container.Name: Cuesheet
Container.Overview: Cuesheet is a calm media dashboard: what's playing on Plex/Jellyfin right now, what was recently added, what Radarr and Sonarr expect this week, and a Seerr-backed request box. Open the web UI after starting and the setup wizard walks you through connecting each service (the variables below are optional). All API keys stay inside the container; the browser only ever talks to Cuesheet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Settings saved through the in-app setup wizard are stored here.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional shared password; you can also set one in the app, and enable Plex/Jellyfin sign-in there. Admins can open Settings and see who is streaming.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the config folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the config folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA time zone used for the weekly calendar.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to true to show sample data without connecting any service. Turn off once your URLs and keys are filled in.

Config.Name: Your Name
Config.Description: Used in the greeting, e.g. 'Good evening, Christopher'.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Small label shown above the greeting.

Config.Name: App Title
Config.Description: Wordmark shown in the sidebar.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Plex server URL (LAN address of Apollo works). Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: X-Plex-Token. Plex > any item > Get Info > View XML, then copy the token from the URL.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin server URL. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin > Dashboard > API Keys.

Config.Name: Jellyfin User ID
Config.Description: Optional. When set, Recently Added uses this user's library view.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr URL. Leave blank to disable movie releases in the calendar.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr > Settings > General > API Key.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Sonarr URL. Leave blank to disable episodes in the calendar.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr > Settings > General > API Key.

Config.Name: Seerr URL
Config.Description: Overseerr or Jellyseerr URL. Leave blank to hide the Requests section.

Config.Name: Seerr API Key
Config.Description: Seerr > Settings > General > API Key.

Config.Name: Seerr User ID
Config.Description: Optional. Make requests on behalf of this Seerr user id instead of the API key owner.

Config.Name: Refresh Seconds
Config.Description: How often the browser refreshes Now Playing.

Config.Name: Recently Added Limit
Config.Description: Number of posters in the Recently Added row.
